post_title: Tips for F1 Applicants struggling with the May, June 2026 Slot Scarcity in India
concerns_or_questions_summary: Advisory/blog-style post offering tips to F-1 applicants facing May–June 2026 slot scarcity in India, covering bulk-drop release patterns at the five Indian consulates, the high F-1 rejection rate, portal-refresh lockouts, the end of third-country stamping in Mexico/Canada, and an offer of DS-160 review.
